verdicts.evidence_quote: 5 days as skipper on vessels less than 24m LOA
verdicts.notes: Página RYA reaberta hoje (2026-10-07): texto idêntico.

verdicts.evidence_quote: 2500 miles on yachts up to 500gt
verdicts.notes: Reaberta hoje: 2500 milhas em iates até 500gt.

verdicts.evidence_quote: 5 passages over 60 miles long, which must include 2 overnight passages and 2 as skipper
verdicts.notes: Reaberta hoje: texto idêntico.

verdicts.evidence_quote: At least half the qualifying sea time should be gained in tidal waters and on vessels less than 24m LOA
verdicts.notes: Reaberta hoje: nota (1) idêntica.

verdicts.evidence_quote: Minimum age 18 at the time of the exam
verdicts.notes: Reaberta hoje: idade mínima 18 na data do exame.

verdicts.evidence_quote: 8-12 hours for 1 candidate, 10-18 hours for 2 candidates
verdicts.notes: Reaberta hoje: form of exam Practical, durações idênticas.

verdicts.evidence_quote: A GMDSS compliant Marine Radio Operator's Certificate such as the RYA Short Range Certificate, or higher. An RYA First Aid Certificate or another valid first aid certificate
verdicts.notes: Reaberta hoje: rádio GMDSS, primeiros socorros e ID com foto exigidos.

verdicts.evidence_quote: There is no formal training course leading up to the exam
verdicts.notes: Reaberta hoje: prep week e maior taxa de aprovação com treino RYA constam na página.

verdicts.evidence_quote: All qualifying sea time and passages must be gained on vessels appropriate to the type of exam
verdicts.notes: Reaberta hoje: nota vigente (sail exam = veleiros).

verdicts.evidence_quote: experienced and competent to skipper a vessel of up to 200gt on passages of any length in all parts of the world
verdicts.notes: Reaberta hoje: texto idêntico.

verdicts.evidence_quote: 600M including at least 200M more than 50 miles from land or charted objects capable of being used for navigation
verdicts.notes: Reaberta hoje: pré-requisito vigente idêntico.

verdicts.evidence_quote: Duration of at least 96 hours
verdicts.notes: Reaberta hoje: 96 horas mínimas.

verdicts.evidence_quote: Throughout the passage, the candidate must have acted in a responsible capacity, either in sole charge of a watch or as skipper.
verdicts.notes: Reaberta hoje: texto vigente; planejamento/preparação também exigidos.

verdicts.evidence_quote: Candidates must have successfully navigated a yacht at sea by astro navigation.
verdicts.notes: Reaberta hoje: mínimo sun-run meridian altitude ou sun-run-sun e compass check por astro, conforme afirmado.

verdicts.evidence_quote: The exam consists of an oral and written test.
verdicts.notes: Reaberta hoje: exame oral e escrito; sem prova prática a bordo (sights tomadas no mar são avaliadas por registros).

verdicts.evidence_quote: Candidates who hold the RYA/MCA Yachtmaster Ocean Shorebased Course Completion Certificate (final exam must have been invigilated at an RYA RTC)
verdicts.notes: Reaberta hoje: isenção da escrita vigente (também para STCW oficial de convés).

verdicts.evidence_quote: Only those who hold the RYA Yachtmaster Offshore Certificate of Competence are eligible to receive the RYA Yachtmaster Ocean Certificate of Competence on passing the oral exam.
verdicts.notes: Reaberta hoje: texto idêntico (titulares de OOW recebem só confirmação de aprovação).

verdicts.evidence_quote: exam duration approximately 1.5 to 2 hours
verdicts.notes: Reaberta hoje: 'Exam duration approximately 1.5 to 2 hours'.

verdicts.evidence_quote: The minimum qualifying passage must have been accrued within 10 years of the examination date.
verdicts.notes: Reaberta hoje: texto idêntico.

verdicts.evidence_quote: which can be conducted at an RYA recognised Training Centre, or at another appropriate venue, either in the UK or abroad
verdicts.notes: Reaberta hoje: texto idêntico.

verdicts.evidence_quote: A day on board or as skipper is a period of eight consecutive hours living on board, the majority of which the vessel should have been at sea.
verdicts.notes: Reaberta hoje: idêntico, incluindo um só período de 8 h por 24 h.

verdicts.evidence_quote: A passage is a continuously underway (non-stop) voyage from a departure port / safe haven to a destination port / safe haven.
verdicts.notes: Reaberta hoje: definição e regra da rota navegável mais curta vigentes.

verdicts.evidence_quote: If the skipper's role is transferred to another person at any time during a passage then neither person can claim to have skippered that passage.
verdicts.notes: Reaberta hoje: texto idêntico.

verdicts.evidence_quote: Passages such as recognised races which may not comply exactly with these requirements may be submitted to the RYA for consideration before the voyage.
verdicts.notes: Reaberta hoje: texto idêntico.

verdicts.evidence_quote: Unlike other qualifications in the RYA cruising programme, there is no formal training course to become an RYA Yachtmaster.
verdicts.notes: Reaberta hoje: texto idêntico.

verdicts.evidence_quote: The Coastal and Offshore exams are practical tests afloat, whilst the exam for Yachtmaster Ocean is an oral exam.
verdicts.notes: Reaberta hoje: texto idêntico.

verdicts.evidence_quote: Exam Fee 2026 Yachtmaster Offshore £266.00 Yachtmaster Coastal & Powerboat Advanced £230.00 Yachtmaster Ocean £199.00
verdicts.notes: Tabela 'Exam fees 2026' reaberta hoje com os mesmos valores.

verdicts.evidence_quote: The SRC exam fee is £76 ... payable to the RYA and is separate to the fee that you pay for the training course.
verdicts.notes: Reaberta hoje: £76 também confere com a tabela de taxas 2026.

verdicts.evidence_quote: Course length 10 hours plus exam time. ... either online or in the classroom with the exam taking place in the classroom.
verdicts.notes: Reaberta hoje: texto vigente.

verdicts.evidence_quote: SRC exams include a written theory question paper and a practical assessment on the use of marine VHF radios.
verdicts.notes: Reaberta hoje: exame conduzido em RYA Recognised Training Centre.
